UK rule (hard limit or requirement): Age of majority 18 (E&W). Criminal offence to send credit invitations to minors (CCA s.50). No maximum age in law; age MAY be used as a risk factor if based on relevant, reliable information (Equality Act Sch.3 para 20A). Nationality is part of "race" (Equality Act s.9), so it cannot be used to refuse or price credit. Residence is not a protected characteristic (verify).
No rule; left to the lender, subject to CONC 5.2A affordability.

Must assess BOTH credit risk and affordability risk before lending or a significant limit increase; repay out of income without borrowing, missing other commitments, or significant adverse impact; must not rely only on the customer's own income statement without independent evidence (generally).

Must demonstrate affordability (MCOB 11.6.2R), evidence income. Stress test: likely rates over 5 years (none if fixed 5+ yrs), MINIMUM +1 percentage point assumption. FPC affordability test (old +3pp) withdrawn 1 Aug 2022. FCA (FS25/6) says no further change needed.
citation: MCOB 11.6.2R, 11.6.18R; FPC 2022; FCA stress-test page (B6-B8, B42-B43)

UK rule (hard limit or requirement): FPC AGGREGATE limit stays: ≤15% of new mortgages at LTI ≥ 4.5. From 28 Oct 2026 the per-lender 15% cap is removed (PS19/26); lenders may exceed 15% while the market aggregate is within 15%; PRA publishes quarterly aggregate and may require gradual reduction. De minimis: <£150m or <300 mortgages.
No regulatory LTV cap (capital risk weights only). No maximum term or age; prudent assessment of income into retirement.

Minimum payment ≥ interest + fees + 1% of balance. Persistent debt: 18-month test (paid less principal than interest/fees), interventions at 18/27/36 months, forbearance, card suspension. Must not raise limit if customer opted out or at risk of financial difficulty; customers can decline/reduce; 30 days' notice of increases.
HCSTC only: 0.8%/day initial cost cap, £15 default cap, 100% total cost cap (retained Sept 2026). No cap on mainstream loans, cards, mortgages; price controlled by Consumer Duty fair value.

Arrears/default charges no higher than necessary to cover reasonable costs. Right to repay early (s.94). Early-repayment compensation (unsecured fixed-rate only): max 1% of amount repaid if >1 year left, 0.5% if ≤1 year, never more than interest saved; only if >£8,000 repaid in 12 months.
citation: CONC 7.7.5R area; CCA s.95A (B16, B27, B31)

UK rule (hard limit or requirement): 14 days, no reason needed; repay credit + interest within 30 days; no fee. Not for mortgages / secured on land / >£60,260.

CRA check "where necessary" (proportionate), not mandatory for every loan. Solely automated significant decisions allowed (since 5 Feb 2026) except with special category data / recognised-legitimate-interest basis; MUST offer info, representations, human intervention and right to contest.
citation: CONC 5.2A; UK GDPR Arts 22A-22D via DUAA 2025 s.80, SI 2026/82 (B25, B32)

UK rule (hard limit or requirement): Deliver good outcomes; good faith; avoid foreseeable harm; enable and support; four outcomes incl. fair value; vulnerable customers considered throughout.
Support customers IN or AT RISK OF payment difficulty; range of forbearance options; individual circumstances; sustainable arrangements; signpost free debt advice (from 4 Nov 2024).

Regulated from 15 July 2026 (PS26/1). Interest-free, ≤12 instalments, ≤12 months. CONC 5.2A applies to every transaction; product info (CONC 4.2A); missed-payment info (CONC 7.20); FOS jurisdiction. CRA reporting not mandatory.
Equality Act 2010 (s.29 services; race incl. nationality; age exception for financial services). FCA: no AI-specific rules; Consumer Duty + SM&CR apply.
citation: EqA 2010; FCA AI approach page (B23-B24, B39)

UK rule (hard limit or requirement): IFRS 9: rebuttable presumption of SICR at >30 dpd (Stage 2); rebuttable presumption of default no later than 90 dpd (Stage 3).
PRA SS1/23: 5 principles; effective 17 May 2024; republished 23 Apr 2026. Formal scope = banks with IRB/IMA/IMM approval; covers all decision models incl. AI/ML.

Pre-contract info (SECCI under CCA disclosure regs; DPC uses CONC 4.2A). Representative APR + representative example when triggered; rep APR = rate ≥51% of agreements expected to get. Under review (CP26/15; CCA reform moving info rules into FCA rules).
citation: CONC 3.5; FCA CP26/15; HMT CCA reform (B34, B40)
